import numpy as np

def r(x):
    # Input transform: Identity.
    # The conservation-type invariant here is the conservation of the input value,
    # which implies the output must be invariant (conserved) under repeated calls
    # with the same input (determinism).
    return x

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # Output relation: Equality check.
    # This relation verifies that the program output is conserved when the input
    # is conserved. A defect eroding this property (e.g., non-determinism due to
    # uninitialized memory or reliance on global state) will cause R to fail.
    return np.isclose(y_orig, y_new, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12)
